title: File-change tracking visits ~8300 sessions per batch of ~74 changes and waits 300–470 ms for the state lock
outcome: File-change tracking work scales with the number of eligible sessions, not with the total retained session population. It does no avoidable scan or I/O under the state lock, and its repeated log line is rate-limited or demoted. Measured before and after on the running host.
acceptance: File-change tracking visits ~8300 sessions per batch of ~74 changes and waits 300–470 ms for the state lock is done
